card.name: Start of S-words about curves and shapes
card.fires_on: Responds to an initial 's' or 'S' sound piece starting a word, often in descriptions of curved or flat shapes, such as sine curve, S-curve, spine curvature or flat-topped surfaces. It also fires on a few odd word starts like 'belt' in crowned belts.

modes.label: Letter S in curve contexts
modes.description: A lone 's' or 'S' beginning a word or naming a curve shape such as an S-curve or kyphosis disease name.
modes.example: See example of below for creating a simple ‘<<s>>’ curve.

modes.label: Hyphenated shape compounds
modes.description: A hyphen piece after 'flat' or 'temperature' that begins a compound describing a surface or sensing device.
modes.example: small, shiny, flat<<-t>>opped, itchy pink or purple raised

modes.label: Anatomy and technical S-words
modes.description: The start of a word like sacrovertebral or Scheuermann's in anatomy text about spinal curvature.

card.writes: It pushes toward curve, axis, contour and slope words, so it predicts graph or shape vocabulary next.
card.plain: It lights up at the start of words in descriptions of curves, bends and flat shapes, such as spinal curvature or S-curves.
